# Bradley University

> > Bradley University is a private institution in Illinois offering undergraduate and graduate programs with strong academic partnerships including Illinois Central College, DePaul Law, and UICOMP.

Bradley provides comprehensive academic resources including specialized institutes like the C.C. Wheeler Institute, continuing education programs in data analytics and STEAM enrichment, and extensive special collections through the Virginius H. Chase Center. The university maintains robust transfer pathways and early assurance programs for students pursuing law and medical careers.

## Key Topics

- Graduate Admissions
- Academic Partnerships
- Transfer Pathways (Path2BU)
- Illinois Central College
- DePaul University College of Law
- University of Illinois College of Medicine Peoria
- Early Assurance Programs
- Pre-Law and Pre-Med Programs
- Continuing Education
- Data Analytics Certificate
- Special Collections and University Archives
- Virginius H. Chase Special Collections Center
- Scholarships and Financial Aid
- Online Learning Programs
- STEAM Education (World of Wonder)

## Admissions and Financial Aid

- [Graduate Admissions](https://www.bradley.edu/admissions/graduate): Graduate program admissions requirements including TOEFL, GRE, GMAT
- [Scholarships & Grants](https://www.bradley.edu/admissions/financial-aid/scholarships-grants): University, Presidential, and Dean's scholarships and grant programs

## Academic Partnerships and Transfer Programs

- [Academic Partnerships](https://www.bradley.edu/academic-partnerships): Transfer pathways with Illinois Central College, DePaul Law, and UICOMP

## Continuing Education and Professional Development

- [Data Analytics Certificate](https://www.bradley.edu/academics/continuing-education/data-analytics): Non-credit online certificate program in data analytics
- [World of Wonder](https://www.bradley.edu/academics/continuing-education/world-of-wonder): Summer STEAM enrichment program for grades 1-9 students

## Academic Centers and Institutes

- [C.C. Wheeler Institute](https://www.bradley.edu/academics/academic-institutes/c-c-wheeler-institute): Holistic study of family well-being through College of EHS
- [International Trade Center](https://www.bradley.edu/academics/academic-centers/turner-center-for-entrepreneurship/international-trade-center): Illinois SBDC export assistance and trade counseling services

## Library and Special Collections

- [Special Collections and Centers](https://www.bradley.edu/academics/library/collections-centers): Virginius H. Chase Special Collections Center and University Archives

## Student Services and Support

- [Academic Dates and Deadlines](https://www.bradley.edu/academics/classes/spring/deadlines): Spring semester and January interim registration deadlines calendar
- [Who to Contact](https://www.bradley.edu/academics/classes/fall/contact): Campus department contact directory for student services

## Alumni and Giving

- [Giving At Bradley](https://www.bradley.edu/alumni/giving): Philanthropic giving opportunities including The Bradley Fund

## Optional

- [Committee on the Use of Human Subjects in Research](https://www.bradley.edu/academics/academic-offices/sponsored-programs/cuhsr): IRB review and research ethics protocol approval for human subjects
- [Accessibility](https://www.bradley.edu/legal-accessibility): Digital accessibility commitment and accommodations information
